page.layout: One printed page: running head at top; heading line with caption beside a woodcut; woodcut illustration of a banquet table with spectators; below the woodcut a verse epigram set in lines with a large initial; a signature-like line "Ænea" at lower right. No margin notes.

main_text.head: Spectatores, mensam dapibus & poculis onustam taciti spectantes. VII.
main_text.p: Nil spectasse dapes, nil deglutisse iuuabit, Hac nisi ventriculi cuncta calore coquas. Sic coetus spectasse pios, diuinaque verba Audisse, attenta nil licet aure iuuat, Hac nisi percipiatque fides, imoque reposta Pectore, diuino freta calore coquat.

page.notes: The initial N of the first verse is a large decorated letter. The verse lines are italic. The woodcut shows a table with dishes and a goblet before standing spectators; it is not text. Some letters in the verse are partly obscured by the woodcut edge and printed show-through; "reposta" last letter may be a Cyrillic-like a and is uncertain, and "cuncta" and "ventriculi" readings are approximate in the scan.
